purpose: Verifies data integrity by calculating and comparing cryptographic hash checksums.
capability: Computes MD5/SHA256/SHA512 checksum of string or bytes and checks against target expected hash.
interface: index.py -> verify_data_hash(data: str | bytes, expected_hash: str, algorithm: str = 'sha256') -> dict
composition: Can be composed with read-file-content to verify file download integrity.
failure_behavior: Raises ValueError if hash algorithm is unsupported.
operational_readiness: Production ready. Uses standard hashlib library.
